segments.text: Still waiting for heavy CAD software just to check what's inside a file?
segments.subtitle: Tired of heavy CAD load times?

segments.text: Meet ModelPeek — the native 3D preview extension for Windows Explorer.
segments.subtitle: Meet ModelPeek: Native Windows 3D Preview

segments.text: Instant 3D thumbnails for STEP, STL, and OBJ files directly in your folders.
segments.subtitle: Instant 3D Thumbnails (STEP / STL / OBJ)

segments.text: Select any model, and an interactive 3D viewport appears right in the preview pane.
segments.subtitle: Interactive Right-Pane 3D Viewport

segments.text: Rotate in 3D, inspect geometry, switch to wireframe mode, and snap camera angles.
segments.subtitle: Wireframe Mesh & Multi-Angle Orthographic Views

segments.text: Check dimensions, vertex counts, and faces with zero delay.
segments.subtitle: Real-time HUD Dimensions & Face Stats
